summary: Full backend + frontend testing of SmartPaw Food landing page. Backend pytest suite (7 tests) all pass - leads CRUD, validation, ordering, persistence verified. Frontend desktop + mobile flows all pass: hero headline, header & hero CTAs open modal, valid signup persists & shows success, language toggle EN<->KA works, WhatsApp FAB href correct, partners marquee has 14 images, how-it-works smooth scroll works, mobile drawer opens with nav links. No console errors observed.

integration_issues.issue: Invalid email is blocked by native HTML5 input[type=email] tooltip rather than rendering data-testid='signup-error-message'. Modal correctly stays open and submission is prevented, but the in-modal red error banner (signup-error-message) only renders for server/network errors. Review request expected the testid'd error banner. Non-blocking - native validation provides equivalent UX.

action_items: Optional: surface a custom in-modal error via data-testid='signup-error-message' when client-side email regex fails (current behavior relies on browser tooltip from type=email + required). Not blocking - submission is correctly prevented and modal stays open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/leads stores created_at as ISO string but model on read expects datetime; conversion is done at read time - OK, but consider storing as native BSON datetime for proper Mongo sort. Current lexicographic sort on ISO-8601 happens to work because UTC ISO strings sort correctly.

SignupModal: relying purely on HTML5 email validation means the custom signup-error-message testid is not exercised on invalid input. Add client-side validation to render the testid'd error for consistency with PRD/tests.
Lots of unused shadcn /ui/* files in components/ui — flagged as known/intentional by main agent; safe to ignore.
No rate limiting on /api/leads — public lead capture endpoint can be spammed. Consider rate limit or captcha for production.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed leads created during pytest run (persisted in MongoDB db.leads collection)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py. All endpoints under /api/leads working. Frontend public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All data-testids per /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js. Note that the only minor gap is that invalid-email validation uses HTML5 native tooltip instead of rendering the signup-error-message banner — modal correctly stays open in both cases.
